about.intro: We are the crew behind Insel1o1 — building a learning world where education feels like an adventure across islands.
about.missionContent: Transform learning into an exploration experience where students, parents, and teachers progress through knowledge like discovering new islands.
about.visionContent: A world where education feels like exploration, not obligation.

captain.title: Captain of Learning Worlds
captain.description: Vision, direction and overall concept of Insel1o1. Shapes the learning universe and connects education with adventure-based exploration.

navigator.title: Learning Navigator
navigator.description: Educational structure and learning design. Designs learning paths, ensures clarity in progression, and makes sure students, parents and teachers understand the learning journey.

pobbie.title: Pobbie – The Code Rabbit 🐰
pobbie.description: Developer and system builder. Builds and implements the entire platform, turns ideas into working systems, and brings the learning world to life through code.
